question: Can query-conditioned edge relevance suppress high-weight generic hub drift without harming clean or unlabeled/OOD graph traversal?

fixture.negative_space_control: CONFLICT path may be observed but may not relay

qcep_0_1.adjudication: REFUTED_FOR_PROMOTION: missing edge semantics were incorrectly treated as negative evidence.

qcep_0_2_structural_reproduction.rule: Enable query conditioning only when at least one ADMISSIBLE outgoing edge at the current source has positive query signal; otherwise use exact static edge factor. Inadmissible targets cannot manufacture conditioning pressure.

supported: Unconditional semantic downweighting can create an OOD recall regression when relation labels are absent.
Treating absent admissible local edge semantics as UNKNOWN rather than counterevidence removes that regression in the structural reproduction while retaining the poisoned-hub benefit.
not_supported: Universal superiority over databases, graph engines, vector search, or RAG systems.

next_falsifiers: Run exact current-main branch unit tests and poison/clean/unlabeled differential on self-hosted Ubuntu.
Run QCEP as the current U15 typed evidence-gap expander under a matched item budget.
Run held-out current Clay relation families with independently adjudicated relevance.
Inject stale, ambiguous, CONFLICT and high-degree-hub edges and require fail-closed/no-laundering behavior.
Compare matched-budget PostgreSQL/pgvector or graph-engine baselines before broader superiority claims.
